title: Nelson City Council — Queens Gardens

facts.fact: Queens Gardens opened1892 and retains Victorian design around the former Maitai River bend/Eel Pond.
Central access is from Bridge and Tasman Streets, beside the Suter gallery.
Features include rose garden, fountain, waterwheel, bridges and heritage planting; no current flower display guaranteed.
Huangshi garden opened14November2007 and reflects Nelson friendship with Huangshi.
